title: Link Lock
gameplaySummary: What Makes It Unique Link Lock must be different from nearby modes: Link Lock must be different from nearby modes: unlike Maze Rush, the player is not a traveler moving through corridorsunlike Pipe Pulse, there is no live pressure flow systemunlike Circuit Clash, there are no electrical objective chains or relays as the primary identityunlike Tile Shift, the puzzle is not about rearranging the whole boardunlike Score Attack / Combo Rush / Clear Rush, it is not about clearing clustersunlike Mirror Maze, the challenge is not reflection logicunlike Spatial Spin, rotation is not the main feature unlike Maze Rush, the player is not a traveler moving through corridors | Win: Win Condition A player wins by: A player wins by: | Players: 4

spriteSheets.styleNotes: Precise circuit-trace lines. Low = dim gray. High = bright cyan. Error = red flash overlay. Transparent base for board integration.
